_comment: Client registry for the HTTP transport. Which client_ids (from the JWT) may call, and the most scopes each may ever get. Optional per-entry "environments" (local/dev/test/production): entries load only where tagged, and production requires every entry to be tagged for production. Non-secret. Client IDs and token scope names are PLACEHOLDERS: replace with your real ones. There is NO per-customer boundary: a client with read can read any account (accepted risk, docs/08 §1).

scope_map._comment: token scope string -> server permission. Token scopes not listed here are ignored (fail closed).

lowerenv-shared.description: The ONE shared client ID for all lower environments (people + automation). read only. Tagged so production refuses to start if it ever appears in a production registry (guardrail G2, docs/08 §5).

care-agent-internal.description: Internal care agent: may see unmasked PII.
